02 Project overview

A designed technical system

The site is designed as a personal technical magazine. Software, tools, systems, and experiments are presented editorially, with project details shaped as publication pages rather than promotional case studies.

The visual language intentionally avoids a generic developer-portfolio or SaaS aesthetic. Hierarchy comes from typography, spacing, project metadata, and technical surfaces.

04 Implementation

Static pages generated from canonical data

The publication uses static HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. A canonical project data file drives the homepage and Work directory, while a Node-based generator creates the complete Project Detail pages.

The site is compatible with static deployment through GitHub Pages. Responsive layouts support desktop and mobile, and motion is restrained with reduced-motion support.
